entities.summary: Jean-Pierre Batut is a French bishop and theologian. Appointed bishop of Blois and installed there on 11 January 2015, he served in the Issy-lès-Moulineaux seminary near Paris, and as Curé of Ste. Jeanne de Chantal church in the XVIe Arrondissement of Paris before being appointed auxiliary bishop of Lyon.
